title: Digital marketing starter
description: Analytics, ads and social tools, plus prompts for SEO checks, ad copy, social posts and reports.

items.name: SEO check this page
items.prompt: Check this page ({{page}}) for SEO: title tag and meta description (with their lengths), heading structure, image alt text, internal links and anything that slows it down. List the 5 fixes with the most impact first, and give the exact new text where a rewrite helps.

items.name: Social posts from page
items.prompt: Read this page and write three posts about it: one for LinkedIn (professional, under 1,300 characters), one for X (under 280 characters) and an Instagram caption with 5 relevant hashtags. Use only facts from the page.

items.name: Competitor teardown
items.prompt: Read this competitor page and summarise: who it targets, the main offer, pricing signals, calls to action and proof (testimonials, logos, numbers). Put that in a table, then give 3 ideas we could test in response.

items.name: Ad copy variants
items.prompt: Write 5 Google Ads headlines (30 characters max) and 4 descriptions (90 characters max) for {{ask: What are we promoting? | the product on this page}}. Show the character count after each line and vary the angle: benefit, urgency, proof, question, offer.

items.name: Campaign brief
items.prompt: Draft a one-page campaign brief for {{ask: Campaign name or goal?}}: objective, audience, key message, channels, budget split, KPIs and timeline. Ask me about anything important that is missing instead of guessing.

items.name: Rewrite in brand voice
items.prompt:
Rewrite this in a clear, warm, confident voice with no jargon, then give 2 shorter alternatives:

{{selection}}

items.name: Weekly report email
items.prompt: From the dashboard on this page, pull the key numbers (traffic, conversions, spend, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend) and compare them with the previous period. Then draft a short email to {{ask: Who gets the report? | my manager}} with the highlights, one concern and next steps, and open it as a draft.
